originalTitle: Jim Cramer highlights 5 investing themes — and the stocks to buy for each
summary: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said earnings season reinforced five investing themes he thinks will produce the market's best buying opportunities.
content:
CNBC's Jim Cramer said Thursday earnings season has revealed investing themes he thinks will produce the market's best buying opportunities.

"I love themes. They help you craft a portfolio of stocks with the wind at their backs, not in their faces — the kind of stocks that you can confidently buy more of when they go down," the " Mad Money " host said.

For investors trying to decide what stocks to buy, Cramer said a good place to start is by focusing on broader market themes to narrow the field. He said the latest earnings season has reinforced five themes that he thinks can help investors identify attractive stocks.

The first theme, Cramer said, is a surprisingly resilient consumer. Despite widespread concerns about inflation and slowing spending, he said earnings from banks, travel companies and retailers tell a different story .

"We've been told over and over that the consumer's totally stretched," he said. "The companies are saying otherwise."

Cramer said investors looking to capitalize on that theme should consider companies tied to consumer spending, including Capital One and American Express , as well as retailers Ralph Lauren and Williams-Sonoma , which he said continue to benefit from healthy discretionary demand. Cramer's Charitable Trust , the portfolio run by CNBC's Investing Club, owns shares of Capital One.

Artificial intelligence infrastructure remains another powerful theme, but Cramer said investors should focus on companies supplying semiconductor equipment, rather than those scrambling to buy memory.

"There is a shortage of every kind of memory in the universe of the data center," he said, highlighting Lam Research , KLA Corp and Applied Materials as his preferred way to capitalize on that demand.

Cybersecurity also continues to stand out, Cramer said. Earlier this year, some investors questioned whether artificial intelligence would reduce the need for dedicated security software, but he said rising cyber threats have reinforced the importance of companies such as CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks . Cramer's Charitable Trust owns shares of CrowdStrike and Palo Alto.

Cramer also expects a pickup in mergers and acquisitions to become a tailwind for Wall Street. He thinks companies are moving quickly to pursue deals while the regulatory environment remains favorable, creating opportunities for investment banks including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley . Cramer's Charitable Trust owns shares of Goldman Sachs.

Finally, he said healthcare has become an attractive destination for investors looking to diversify beyond technology without giving up exposure to innovation . Cramer highlighted Eli Lilly and Johnson & Johnson , which Cramer's Charitable Trust owns, as companies benefiting from that trend.

While no investing theme is guaranteed to outperform, Cramer said identifying durable trends gives investors greater conviction to hold — and even add to — positions during inevitable pullbacks.

"I just think this quarter's information is fresh enough that you can pick a travel stock, a semiconductor capital equipment maker, a cybersecurity company, something that works in the M&A world, or medtech and you'll greatly increase your chances of making money for the rest of 2026," he said.

chineseTitle: 吉姆·克莱默 重点介绍了 5 个投资主题，以及每个主题值得购买的股票
chineseSummary: CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 表示，财报季强化了五个投资主题，他认为这将带来市场最佳的买入机会。
chineseContent:
CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 表示，周四的财报季揭示了他认为将带来市场最佳买入机会的投资主题。

“我喜欢主题。它们可以帮助你打造一个股票投资组合，顺风顺水，而不是逆风而上——这种股票在下跌时你可以放心地买入更多股票，”《Mad Money》主持人说道。

克莱默表示，对于试图决定购买哪些股票的投资者来说，一个好的起点是关注更广泛的市场主题，以缩小范围。他表示，最新的财报季强化了五个主题，他认为这些主题可以帮助投资者识别有吸引力的股票。

克莱默说，第一个主题是消费者的弹性惊人。尽管人们普遍担心通货膨胀和支出放缓，但他表示，银行、旅游公司和零售商的收益却讲述了不同的故事。

“我们一遍又一遍地被告知，消费者已经完全捉襟见肘了，”他说。 “公司的说法并非如此。”

克莱默表示，希望利用这一主题的投资者应该考虑与消费者支出相关的公司，包括第一资本和美国运通，以及零售商拉尔夫劳伦和威廉姆斯索诺玛，他表示这些公司继续受益于健康的可自由支配需求。由 CNBC 投资俱乐部运营的克莱默慈善信托基金 (Cramer's Charitable Trust) 持有第一资本 (Capital One) 的股份。

人工智能基础设施仍然是另一个强大的主题，但克莱默表示，投资者应该关注供应半导体设备的公司，而不是那些争先恐后购买内存的公司。

他表示：“数据中心领域的各种内存都存在短缺。”他强调 Lam Research、KLA Corp 和 Applied Materials 是他利用这一需求的首选方式。

克莱默说，网络安全也继续脱颖而出。今年早些时候，一些投资者质疑人工智能是否会减少对专用安全软件的需求，但他表示，不断上升的网络威胁增强了 CrowdStrike 和 Palo Alto Networks 等公司的重要性。克莱默慈善信托基金 (Cramer's Charitable Trust) 拥有 CrowdStrike 和帕洛阿尔托 (Palo Alto) 的股份。

克莱默还预计，并购活动的增加将成为华尔街的推动力。他认为，在监管环境依然有利的情况下，企业正在迅速采取行动寻求交易，这为包括高盛和摩根士丹利在内的投资银行创造了机会。克莱默慈善信托基金拥有高盛的股份。

最后，他表示，对于那些希望在技术之外实现多元化而又不放弃创新的投资者来说，医疗保健已成为一个有吸引力的目的地。克莱默强调礼来公司和克莱默慈善信托基金拥有的强生公司是受益于这一趋势的公司。

克莱默表示，虽然没有任何投资主题能够保证跑赢大盘，但识别持久趋势可以让投资者更有信心在不可避免的回调期间持有甚至增持头寸。

他表示：“我只是认为本季度的信息足够新鲜，你可以选择一只旅游股票、一家半导体资本设备制造商、一家网络安全公司、在并购领域有效的公司或医疗科技公司，这样你在 2026 年剩余时间里赚钱的机会就会大大增加。”
